question.prompt: In isosceles \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=AC=13\), \(BC=10\), and \(AD\perp BC\) at \(D\). Find the length of \(AD\).

solutions.explanation: The altitude, median, and vertex-angle bisector coincide, so \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\). Thus, \(BD=5\) and \(AD=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=12\).
solutions.title: Bisect the base and use Pythagoras
